 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Jacksonville State football is back on the road, facing Western Kentucky to continue Conference USA play.
 In their last game, the Gamecocks (5-2) rolled in the fourth quarter, thanks to a 16-point swing in two minutes towards a 47-14 over Sam Houston State. Caden Creel threw for two touchdowns and ran for another, the first time he has done that this season. He threw for more than 240 yards and ran for more than 85 yards for the third time this season.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The Gamecocks are tied with Liberty at the top of the conference. Jax State can clinch a spot in the Conference USA title game with a win on Saturday. It would be a third straight conference title game appearance for the Gamecocks, who won the 2024 edition and have hosted the last two games.
 The Gamecocks will return to play Nov. 7, traveling up the road to face off with Western Kentucky (3-6, 2-3 CUSA). The game will stream on ESPN+ and kickoffs at 2:30 p.m. CT.
